tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_effect = {
	location:shanyang_huaian = {
		if = {
			limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_grand_canal_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_grand_canal }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt }
				change_variable = { name = tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_restore_effect = {
	location:shanyang_huaian = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt > 0 }
				tv_wonder_raise_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_grand_canal }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt = 1 }
					remove_variable = tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = tv_vw_unique_grand_canal_damage_debt subtract = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
